verdict.rationale: Buzz documents creating channels with private or open visibility ("Name it, describe it, make it private"; `buzz channels create ... --visibility open`) and per-principal channel memberships, including a benchmarked create-channel-invite-users flow on NIP-29 relay-based groups. Community critique of the private-group permission model is skepticism rather than a documented failure, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented admin membership management (removing members, roles or permissions per channel, join policies), and hands-on corroboration that private channels enforce access.
